# stronger than

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:strongerThan`](gmeow-strongerThan.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/strongerThan>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)

Orders authority levels: the subject level carries more claimed authority than the object level. Transitive ON LEVELS ONLY (the [`gmeow:coarserThan`](gmeow-coarserThan.md) pattern) — norms themselves are ordered by pairwise [`gmeow:overrides`](gmeow-overrides.md) claims, never transitively.
